description: Run the project's unit tests with GUT or GdUnit4 (whichever is installed in addons/) in a separate headless Godot process started by the editor, and return pass/fail counts, every failing test with its message, and errors from the log. Use it for game logic; use scenario_run for play. Failing tests are a normal result (not a tool error).

path.description: Test folder or one test script, e.g. 'res://test/unit' or 'res://test/unit/test_player.gd'. Default: res://test or res://tests (GUT: the folders in res://.gutconfig.json when it exists).

report.description: 'full' adds the JSON result with every test's status.

test.description: GUT only: run the tests whose name contains this, e.g. 'test_jump'.

timeout_ms.description: Stop the run after this long (default 120000).

name: test_run
title: Run unit tests
